key.name: provider-instances-json
key.description: Versioned JSON definitions of the Codex, Claude, Kiro, and Antigravity accounts Token Grill monitors.

key.name: configuration-version
key.description: Format version of the stored account definitions, used to migrate older configurations.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Whether to notify when an account’s selected limit crosses a usage step.

key.name: notification-step-percent
key.description: Percentage of the limit between two usage notifications for the same account.

key.name: notification-test-request
key.description: Transient request written by Preferences: a JSON object with the account identifier and a nonce. The running extension sends one test notification per nonce.

key.name: active-provider-id
key.description: Identifier of the account shown in the top bar.

key.name: panel-percentage-mode
key.description: Show the remaining or the consumed percentage of the selected limit.

key.name: panel-display-style
key.description: Show the selected limit in the top bar as text, a ring, or a bar.
